method.tracking_xy_metric: sqrt(mean(component errors squared over both xy components))
method.hip_target: Every model uses its own physical action scales; both recent ROA policies use hip .125.
method.reset_exclusion: done step and following 49 steps excluded; differences only between consecutive valid samples; displacement and heading null for windows containing done
method.estimated_velocity: student minus same-step pre-action truth; not post-action root velocity
method.per_joint_target_units: first eight rad, last two rad/s; wheel/leg raw magnitudes not directly comparable
method.spectrum: Mean-subtracted rectangular-window RFFT with one-sided Parseval weights; fixed 50 Hz sampling; 5-25 and 10-25 Hz bands; excludes windows with resets; not physics-substep or hardware spectra
method.supplemental_historical_metric: Hip position band RMS derived from existing validated telemetry; no policy inference

limitations: One seed and one environment; simulation evidence only.
30 ms action delay exceeds the trained 0-15 ms range; sensor age is not reproduced.
Physical target metrics describe requests before actuator buffering.
Independently trained policies do not isolate the causal effect of deleting a velocity input.
policy_description_required: 仅可进入受监督实物测试；未经实物验证，不代表 hardware-ready。
